risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrades
risks.summary: Any downgrade by rating agencies would directly increase fees and interest rates on the main credit facility, severely impacting the company's liquidity and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in Capital Structure section (mid-report), strong language 'material adverse impact' repeated twice, stable trend but increasingly complex debt structure ($31B in contractual obligations), credit category weighted heavily for REITs.

risks.title: Debt Refinancing Risk
risks.summary: The company must regularly refinance significant debt ($700M in 2026, $2.3B in 2027-2028) and depends on access to capital markets. Restricted access or higher rates could undermine its ability to fund acquisitions and dividends.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Liquidity and Capital Resources section), massive contractual obligations ($31.1B total, $4.3B due in 2026), implicit language 'depending upon availability and cost of external capital', upward trend with investing activities up 91%.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Risk Concentration
risks.summary: The company holds debt in Canadian dollars and pounds sterling and pre-funds acquisitions in foreign currencies. Exchange rate fluctuations may affect the value of these obligations and consolidated cash flows.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Foreign Currency Translation section and contractual obligations), explicit CAD and GBP exposure ($2.4B in foreign debt), neutral language but observed volatility ($129M variation in 2025), new trend with Amica transaction pre-funded in CAD.

risks.title: Unconsolidated Put-Call Obligations
risks.summary: The company has signed put-call agreements on development projects that could require it to acquire properties for $375.7M if certain conditions are met, creating a potential off-balance-sheet obligation.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Off-Balance Sheet Arrangements section), contingent exposure of $375.7M if conditions are triggered, factual language but hidden off-balance-sheet risk, stable trend but significant amount for future acquisitions.

risks.title: Shareholder Dilution from Massive Issuances
risks.summary: The company issued 70.4 million shares in 2024 and retains $5.6B of remaining issuance capacity under its ATM program, creating significant dilution risk for existing shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Capital Structure and Financing Activities sections), documented massive issuances (70.4M shares in 2024, $7.5B ATM capacity), neutral language but continued dilution, upward trend with ATM program renewed in October 2025.

risks.title: Rising Capital Expenditures
risks.summary: Real estate investment expenditures rose 91% in 2025, mainly in renovations and redevelopments ($675.8M), creating increased pressure on cash flows and financing capacity.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Investing Activities section), investing activities up 91% (additional $4.99B), neutral language but upward trend, renovations and redevelopments up 19%, new development down 47%.

risks.title: Covenant Non-Compliance Risk
risks.summary: Debt agreements contain covenants requiring maintenance of financial ratios, minimum net worth, and limiting indebtedness and acquisitions. Any breach could trigger default clauses.
risks.score_rationale: Mid-report position (Capital Structure section), affirmative language 'in compliance in all material respects' but multiple restrictive covenants (financial ratios, minimum net worth, debt limits), stable trend but complex structure with $31B in obligations.
